01运行前的观察目标02模拟延迟返回、指令切换与参考限幅03代码说明

运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

0.2 秒选第一块槽位 2；0.5 秒旧指令结果不可使用，新结果尚未到达；0.8 秒最后一块已过期。参考每控制周期最多变化 0.05。

python 48_execution-latency_demo.py环境配置

模拟延迟返回、指令切换与参考限幅

48_execution-latency_demo.py
import mathimport torch torch.manual_seed(7) # STEP 1: 三个返回时间不同的预测，第三个属于新指令plans=[ {'obs':0.0,'ready':0.15,'start':0.0,'epoch':0,'values':torch.arange(6).float()*0.1}, {'obs':0.2,'ready':0.33,'start':0.2,'epoch':0,'values':torch.arange(6).float()*0.1+0.25}, {'obs':0.4,'ready':0.53,'start':0.4,'epoch':1,'values':0.2-torch.arange(6).float()*0.1},]dt,max_age=0.1,0.35 # STEP 2: 按当前时间选槽位，不重新播放已经过去的前缀def pick(now,epoch):    candidates=[]    for p in plans:        if p['ready']>now or p['obs']>now or p['epoch']!=epoch or now-p['obs']>max_age:            continue        index=math.floor((now-p['start'])/dt+1e-9)        if 0<=index<len(p['values']):            candidates.append((p['obs'],index,p['values'][index]))    return max(candidates,key=lambda x:x[0]) if candidates else None # STEP 3: 位置与参考变化率区间取交集，不声称约束了实测动力学def bounded_reference(previous,target):    if not torch.isfinite(target).all():        raise ValueError('non-finite target')    lower=torch.maximum(torch.tensor(-0.5),previous-0.5*dt)    upper=torch.minimum(torch.tensor(0.5),previous+0.5*dt)    if (lower>upper).any():        raise ValueError('incompatible reference constraints')    return torch.maximum(lower,torch.minimum(upper,target)) # STEP 4: 新指令切换后拒绝旧结果；过期也不能靠平滑变新previous=torch.tensor(0.0)for tick in range(9):    now=tick*dt    epoch=1 if tick>=5 else 0    selected=pick(now,epoch)    if selected is None:        print(round(now,1),'WAIT: no valid action')        continue  # 真实系统的等待行为由执行状态机定义    source,index,target=selected    previous=bounded_reference(previous,target)    print(round(now,1),'source',source,'slot',index,'reference',round(previous.item(),3))assert pick(0.1,0) is Noneassert pick(0.2,0)[1]==2assert pick(0.5,1) is Noneassert pick(0.8,1) is None
